verdict.rationale: OpenCode is documented as an open source AI coding agent with a terminal-based interface. It installs via curl or npm, runs with `opencode` in any terminal, and has CLI subcommands like `opencode run`; it also supports local models. Community users report running it daily as their primary terminal harness, including with locally hosted models (llama.cpp, Qwen). Missing for 10: one hands-on report of the TUI failing to open on Wayland (Ubuntu 24.04), plus reports of unreliable file edits and session bugs when using local models.
